test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was Asia's first supercomputer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PARAM**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PARAM** was developed by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) in India.
 
• It was launched in the year **1991** and marked India's entry into the field of supercomputing.
 
• PARAM is an acronym for **Parallel Machine**, reflecting its architecture and processing capabilities.
 
• It was a significant milestone in India's technological advancement and placed India among the few countries with supercomputing capabilities at that time.
 
• The development of PARAM was a response to the denial of supercomputing technology to India by other nations, showcasing India's self-reliance in high-performance computing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• CRAY-3, although a notable supercomputer, was developed by the Cray Research company in the United States.
 
• EKA is another Indian supercomputer developed by the Computational Research Laboratories, but it was launched in **2007**.
 
• HITAC S-300 is a supercomputer developed by Hitachi, a Japanese company, and does not hold the distinction of being the first in Asia.
 
• PARAM's successful implementation led to the development of subsequent versions like PARAM 10000 and PARAM Yuva, further advancing India's supercomputing capabilities.
